title: Research beside projects, and lists that fold
lines: In the Works, the tier's screen shows research the way it shows projects: what is being studied and how far it has come, or the first research you can begin, with its button.
The Research button shows how many pieces of research you can put in the line now, as the tier's button does for projects.

more.head: New
points: Done on the tier's screen and Known on the research screen start folded under their label, which shows how many are in them.
Every project and every piece of research to study folds to its name with the arrow at its right. Your folds stay as you left them on this device.
